summary: Iteration 5: tested PDF export + Didit webhook auto-sync (2 new features) + guards + regression. Created /app/backend/tests/test_pdf_and_webhook.py with 12 tests — ALL 12 PASS. Prior regression suite (test_didit_and_regressions.py, 15 tests) still passes 100%. Frontend Playwright: logged in as owner, opened application detail, clicked 'Ekspor PDF' button — browser download intercepted, filename KYB_TEST_PT_Approve_*.pdf, magic bytes %PDF confirmed, and toast 'Laporan PDF diunduh' visible.
critical_code_review_comments: PDF endpoint correctly guards ownership (owner/officer OR applicant_user_id == user.user_id else 403). 404 on missing app. content-type application/pdf. Content-Disposition uses legal_name — safe from spaces via replace, but no sanitization of quotes/newlines in legal_name; low risk given Pydantic input validation.

verify_didit_signature returns True when DIDIT_WEBHOOK_SECRET empty — matches spec (dev/unconfigured accepts). When set, requires x-timestamp within 300s window + x-signature-v2 (HMAC over canonical sorted JSON) OR x-signature-simple (HMAC over ts:session_id:status:webhook_type). Both hmac.compare_digest — good.

didit_webhook idempotency: guarded via `a.get('status') not in ('approved','rejected','auto_rejected')` — but note the didit sub-object IS still updated (session_id/status/last_event_id) even when guard prevents state change. This is intentional & correct for observability, but may cause confusion — didit.status='Declined' can appear on an already-'approved' application (from a late webhook). Acceptable per spec.
Non-decision webhook types return {ok:true} before touching DB — good. Unknown vendor_data also returns {ok:true} gracefully (no info leak).
generate_report_pdf uses reportlab SimpleDocTemplate with sections for company, score breakdown, validation NIB+bank, screening, Didit, decision. PDF rendered ~KB range; %PDF-1.4 header verified.

Minor: didit_webhook does not log incoming event_id anywhere queryable (only stored in didit.last_event_id, overwritten on next event). If audit trail of all webhook events is required, consider append-only collection. Not required by spec.
server.py is 1036 lines — approaching the 700-line split guideline. Consider splitting into routers/{auth,applications,didit,verify,pdf}.py in a future refactor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (PDF export button downloads valid PDF + toast confirmed)
